precedent: High-intensity magnetic separators used in recycling for drum/wet high-intensity magnetic separation of fine ferrous particles and coolant swarf recovery.
response_head:
INTERVENTION: Install a high-gradient magnetic drum separator upstream of the crusher feed line to extract ferrous tramp, paired with a downstream eddy-current separator for residual non-ferrous conductors, both positioned before the crusher chamber to prevent liner impact.
MECHANISM_CLASS: magnetic_gradient_separation
ROOT_CAUSE: Tramp metal enters the crusher feed due to lack of upstream separation; ferrous objects retain high remanence and permeability, allowing extraction via a high-gradient
